question:
Find the two signs to be interchanged for making the following equation correct.

9 + 6 × 3 − 9 ÷ 1 = 10
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given : 9 + 6 × 3 − 9 ÷ 1 = 10

According to the question, after replacing the signs :

Option 1): × and ÷

9 + 6 × 3 − 9 ÷ 1 = 10 ⇒ 9 + 6 ÷ 3 − 9 × 1 = 10
